# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# The calculated trait values
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20251127.RData")

# The UVP6 data including metadata 
load("data/uvp6_CNN_segmentations_morphotraits_20251125.RData")


theme_set(theme_bw() +
            theme(text = element_text(size=14)))
source("functions/lipid_pump_toolkit.R")

```

1. Need a column of [sample_id, object_id, depth_bin, sample_volume, if_segmented, structural_carbon, lipid_carbon, total_carbon, lipid_fullness]
2. From this, get abundance and concentrations in each 5m bin  (sum / volume)
3. To get depth integration, multiply each depth bin by 5 and then sum. Can also separately sum the upper 200 m 200-500m and 500m ++ to get epipelagic, upper mesopelagic, sequestration depth
```{r}
cope_carbon <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # exclude LOKI data
  filter(source != "LOKI segmented") %>% 
  # Add some object_id metadata
  left_join(segmented.images %>% 
              select(object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise,
                     Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3,
                     is_size_extrapolated, is_bad_image),
            by = "object_id") %>% 
  # filter out bad image segmentations and extrapolated sizes
  filter(is_size_extrapolated == F &
           is_bad_image == F) %>% 
  
  # TODO some of the manually segmented images have no lipid content, fix this in the calculate_traits_from_images file.
  filter(!is.na(waxester_carbon)) %>% 
  select(-c(is_size_extrapolated, is_bad_image))
  

# Integrate to 100 m  bins - could be 50 m at surface?  
# Note that the volumes are totaled here (i.e., not averaging the 5m bin vlaues)
binsize <- 100
# Set the depthBinLabel factors ... applied to Ecopart volume!
# TODO Apply to ecopart volumes!!!
dbs <- all.copepods.uvp6 %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # TODO Alternative depth bins... 0-50, 50-100, 100:500, 500-1000, 1000+ ??
  
  
  # Calculate volumes
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  # arbitrary assignment of layers
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin >= 200 & depthBin < 500,
                         "mesopelagic", "sequestration")) %>% 
  mutate(layer = if_else(depthBin < 200, "epipelagic", layer))

cope_carbon_100m <- cope_carbon %>% 
  
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  # TAdd total volume per depth bin
  left_join(dbs, by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate abundance and carbon concentrations per 5 m depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, depthBin, volume_m3, n5mbins,
           depthBinLabel, layer) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lipid_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            lipid_fullness_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            diapause_respiration_mean = mean(respirationRate_ugCday),
            diapause_duration_mean = mean(diapauseDuration_day), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3,
         lipid_carbon_m3 = lipid_carbon / volume_m3,
         # This should practically be lipid_fullness_mean
         percent_lipid_total_carbon = lipid_carbon / total_carbon * 100) %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:percent_lipid_total_carbon,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") 


# TODO add carbon values for the copepods without segmentations
# If most of these are at the surface, would be good to visualize that
cope_carbon_others_100m <- other.copepods.traits %>% 
  filter(object_id %notin% cope_carbon$object_id) %>% 
  select(object_id, sample_id, sample_cruise,
         Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3,
         total_carbon = structural_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # Add total volume per depth bin
  left_join(dbs, by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate abundance and carbon concentrations per 5 m depth bin
  group_by(sample_id, sample_cruise, depthBin, volume_m3, n5mbins,
           depthBinLabel, layer) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  # Add labels for the depth bins
  mutate(depthBinLabel = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  
  # lengthen data frame
  pivot_longer(cols = abundance:total_carbon_m3,
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
```

# Calculate total respired carbon

Tarling et al. (2022) method for carbon export
1. The total respiration flux is the summation of the product of abundance * diapause duration * respiration rate at each depth layer
2. Overwintering non-predatory mortality rate (beta) = -0.001 day-1
3. The total flux of the stored lipid and structural carbon from overwintering mortality is the fraction of the abundance lost to natural mortality multiplied by either the stored lipid or structural lipid carbon mass.
4. The total C flux is the sum of the total respiration flux + total stored lipid mortality flux + structural carbon mortality flux (ug C m-2 year-1)

The version of this here (need to verify):
1. At each depth bin, calculate the total diapause respiration rate (ug C m-2) by multiplying the depth of the bin layer (100 m) * total of (individual respiration rate ug C s-1) / volume filtered in the depth layer (m-3) * diapause duration (days)
2. Calculate proportion of the assemblage subjected to overwintering mortality at each depth bin. Based on total abundance of the depth bin? Or the abundance represented by each individual and then sum all individuals?

Visser et al. (2017) uses the mortality rate of 0.005 d-1 
```{r}
# TODO For this part, can adjust proportion of epipelagic assemblage that will diapause
# TODO double check the abundance calculation and vertical integration

beta <- -0.001 # day-1
carbexp_tarling <- cope_carbon %>% 
  
  # Cap the diapause duration to 240 days
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = if_else(diapauseDuration_day > 240,
                                                240, diapauseDuration_day)) %>% 
  # Calculate abundance fraction represented by the individual
  mutate(abund = (5*(1/Sampled_volume_m3))) %>%  # 5 is for vertical integration of the 5m depth 
  # Calculate the respired carbon concentration of each individual
  # abundance in m2 * respiration rate in (ug C day-1) * diapause duration (days)
  mutate(tot_c_resp = abund * (respirationRate_ugCday) * diapauseDuration_day ) %>% 
  # Calculate the fraction of the "abundance" subjected to overwintering non-predatory mortality (indivs m-2)
  mutate(mort_frac = abund - 
           (abund * exp(beta * diapauseDuration_day))) %>% 
  # Calculate the structural carbon and lipid carbon loss to natural mortality (ug C m-2)
  mutate(tot_c_struc_mort = mort_frac * structural_carbon * 1000,
         tot_c_lipid_mort = mort_frac * waxester_carbon * 1000) %>% 
  # Calculate the total carbon flux contribution of the individual (ug C m-2 year-1)
  # TODO note that the diapause duration needs to be correct here!
  mutate(tot_c_flux = tot_c_resp + tot_c_struc_mort + tot_c_lipid_mort)

# total carbon flux per cast (not C is converted to grams)
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling %>% 
  # filter(sample_id %in% profiles_to_plot$sample_id) %>% 
  
  # TODO can bin by depth 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(tot_c_flux = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            abundance = sum(abund),
            biomass = sum(abund * total_carbon)  / 1000, # from mg C
            tot_c_resp = sum(tot_c_resp) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            tot_c_struc_mort = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            tot_c_lipid_mort = sum(tot_c_lipid_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # select(-sample_id) %>% 
  # rename with units
  rename('abundance\n(indivs m-2)' = abundance,
         'biomass\n(gC m-2)' = biomass,
         'total carbon flux\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_flux,
         'total respiration flux\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_resp,
         'total mortality flux structural\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_struc_mort,
         'total mortality flux reserve\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_lipid_mort)

summary(carbexp_tarling_samples)

ggplot(carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
         select(-sample_id) %>% 
         pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                     names_to = "param", values_to = "value"),
       aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  ylab("N samples") +
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free") +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12))
# TODO add units (these are indiv/gC m-2 and rates are gC m-2 year-1)


```

## Plot relative contributions
```{r}
# Sort stations by bottom depth
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling %>% 
  # calculate max tow depth
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(tot_c_flux = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            abundance = sum(abund),
            biomass = sum(abund * total_carbon)  / 1000, # from mg C
            tot_c_resp = sum(tot_c_resp) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            tot_c_struc_mort = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            tot_c_lipid_mort = sum(tot_c_lipid_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            maxdepth = max(Depth_5m) + 2.5,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(maxdepth)
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id,
                            levels = carbexp_tarling_samples$sample_id)) %>% 
  rename(respiration = tot_c_resp, mortality_structural = tot_c_struc_mort,
         mortality_lipid = tot_c_lipid_mort) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(respiration, mortality_structural, mortality_lipid),
               names_to = "component", values_to = "c_flux_val")

# list of depths for x axis breaks and labels
xdepth <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, maxdepth) %>%
  mutate(maxdepth2 = floor(maxdepth/100) *100) %>%  # 50 m bins
  group_by(maxdepth2) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(maxdepth2 %notin% c(900,1200,1300,1500,1600)) # remove some points

ggplot(carbexp_tarling_samples, 
       aes(x = sample_id, y = c_flux_val, fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue","black","hotpink")) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = xdepth$sample_id,
                   labels = xdepth$maxdepth) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Stations ordered by cast depth") +
  ylab("Total carbon flux (gC m-2 yr-1)") 

ggplot(carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
         filter(maxdepth > 200), 
       aes(x = sample_id, y = c_flux_val, fill = component)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue","black","hotpink")) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = xdepth$sample_id,
                   labels = xdepth$maxdepth) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  xlab("Stations ordered by cast depth") +
  ylab("Total carbon flux (gC m-2 yr-1)") 


```

```{r}
  filter(sample_id == "am_leg2_tcad1b")

  filter(sample_id == "am_leg2_tcad1b") %>% 
  filter(variable %in% c("abundance_m3","total_carbon_m3")) %>%
```
